Our Awefull Good Story

Three generations of waffle excellence, serving up nostalgia and deliciousness since 1952! 🧇

A Legacy of Flavor

It all started in 1952 when Harold "Waffle" Johnson opened the first Awefull Waffles with a simple dream: to serve the most awefull good waffles in town. Armed with his grandmother's secret Belgian waffle recipe and an unwavering commitment to quality, Harold transformed a small corner diner into a beloved community institution.

The name "Awefull Waffles" came from Harold's playful sense of humor. When customers would exclaim "These waffles are awful!" after their first bite, Harold would grin and reply, "Yes, they're awefull good!" The name stuck, and so did our reputation for exceptional food and service.

Over 70 years later, we're still family-owned and operated, now in our third generation. Harold's grandson, Bobby Johnson, carries on the tradition with the same passion, the same secret recipes, and the same commitment to making every customer feel like family.

Our Values & Commitment

🌾

Quality Ingredients

We source only the finest ingredients: farm-fresh eggs, real vanilla, premium flour, and pure maple syrup. No shortcuts, no compromises – just the best for our customers.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Family Tradition

Every recipe is a family heirloom, passed down through generations. We treat every customer like family because that's what we've always been – one big, waffle-loving family.

❤️

Community Love

We're proud to be part of this amazing community. From supporting local schools to hosting charity events, Awefull Waffles is more than a restaurant – we're neighbors.
